questions.question: What is the mood of much of Psalm 44?
options: A joyful royal psalm honoring the wedding of the king
A festive hymn celebrating a great and bountiful harvest
A wisdom poem comparing the two very different paths
A communal lament feeling rejected by God despite faithfulness
questions.answer: A communal lament feeling rejected by God despite faithfulness

questions.question: What did the psalmist's fathers tell of?
options: The riches God gave to the patriarchs
The law God spoke from Mount Sinai
The deeds God did in driving out the nations
The great temple that God allowed Solomon to build
questions.answer: The deeds God did in driving out the nations

questions.question: The psalm pleads, 'Rise up; come to our help! Redeem us for the sake of your steadfast love.'
In God we have boasted continually, and we will give thanks to your _____ forever.
For your sake we are killed all the day long; we are regarded as sheep to be _____.
